items.source: BeanPostProcessor beans that are autodetected in an ApplicationContext will be ordered according to PriorityOrdered and Ordered semantics. In contrast, BeanPostProcessor beans that are registered programmatically with a BeanFactory will be applied in the order of registration; any ordering semantics expressed through implementing the PriorityOrdered or Ordered interface will be ignored for programmatically registered post-processors. Furthermore, the @Order annotation is not taken into account for BeanPostProcessor beans.
items.translation: 在 `ApplicationContext` 中自动检测到的 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean 将按照PriorityOrdered和Ordered的语义进行排序。相比之下，通过编程方式向 `BeanFactory` 注册的 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean 将按注册顺序应用；对于通过编程方式注册的后置处理器，任何通过实现 `PriorityOrdered` 或 `Ordered` 接口所表达的排序语义都将被忽略。此外，`@Order` 注解不适用于 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean。

items.source: Typically, post-processors that populate beans via marker interfaces or the like will implement postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object, String), while post-processors that wrap beans with proxies will normally implement postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String).
items.translation: 通常，通过标记接口等机制填充 Bean 的后处理器将实现postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object, String)，而用代理包装 Bean 的后处理器通常会实现postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String)。

items.source: An ApplicationContext can autodetect BeanPostProcessor beans in its bean definitions and apply those post-processors to any beans subsequently created. A plain BeanFactory allows for programmatic registration of post-processors, applying them to all beans created through the bean factory.
items.translation: `ApplicationContext` 可以在其 Bean 定义中自动检测 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean，并将这些后置处理器应用于随后创建的任何 Bean。普通的 `BeanFactory` 允许通过编程方式注册后置处理器，并将其应用于通过该 Bean Factory 创建的所有 Bean。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由`InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)`方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他`BeanPostProcessor`回调不同。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source: BeansException - in case of errors
items.translation: BeansException - 在发生错误时

items.source: the bean instance to use, either the original or a wrapped one; if null, no subsequent BeanPostProcessors will be invoked
items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance before any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，在任意 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之前。
